top_signals.title: Israel secures procurement of 12 Apache gunships in last-minute maneuver
top_signals.summary: Israel is set to acquire 12 Apache “Echo” attack helicopters from Boeing, according to an Israeli ministry of defense announcement this week.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: ‘Weaponized light’: KBR’s new base defense technology pits lasers against drones
top_signals.summary: The Pentagon recently selected KBR's Firefly system for a pilot program to test defending U.S. military installations against adversarial drones.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
